name: Ellie Harvie
bio: Ellie Harvie is a prominent Canadian actress, comedian, and director best known for her iconic portrayal of Morticia Addams in the live-action sitcom The New Addams Family (1998–1999) and the quirky, hiccup-prone scientist Dr. Lindsey Novak across the Stargate SG-1 and Stargate Atlantis franchises.
